items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★4 Gorgeous are and awesome dark horror vib
items.summary: Gorgeous are and awesome dark horror vibes, but the live events are pretty lack luster and mostly aimed at late game players. The game itself is also sadly quite a bit repetitive, with little variance in mission types and flows. Combat is pretty fun and with a lot tactics and team options, but you also get an overwhelming number of characters quickly.
